lines.text: The person stands still, then suddenly throws both arms outward and upward, opening the chest and extending the whole body in one sharp, explosive movement.
The person stands with the feet apart and repeatedly loses and recovers balance, shifting weight from one foot to the other while the torso sways in wide, uneven arcs.
The person runs quickly toward the left, changes direction, and runs toward the right, repeatedly reversing direction with energetic arm swings and rapid footwork.
The person bends the knees and jumps upward, reaching both arms as high as possible, then lands and repeats the attempt without reaching the imagined destination.

The person makes several sharp, forceful movements in different directions, then bends the knees and jumps powerfully upward with both arms thrown high. After landing, the person lowers the body to the floor and lies flat, becoming completely still.
